messages:
sean-sales: Hey team — ACME needs a Dedicated POC pool for a Wed demo. They expect a short spike ~120 concurrent requests for ~15m. Can we provision a burst, extend cooldown to avoid thrash, and put a hard cap so they don't blow past POC budget? Also need short-lived API keys for devs + SSO. How are burst minutes billed?

bryan-eng: Yes we can. Default burst cooldown is 10m; we can bump to 30m (1800s) for the POC. We support a hard cap (burst_limit) to stop allocations. Need baseline pool size & region.

sean-sales: Baseline = 4 GPUs (A10G), target burst -> 8 GPUs for 15m. Region = us-west-2. Would prefer a no-overage demo mode if possible.

anya-finance: Billing note: burst capacity is prorated per-minute and billed at committed rate with a burst premium (x1.5) by default. We can set an alert at 80% usage and a hard financial cap. For trials we can also apply a flat $ cap so they can't incur charges beyond approval.

maria-solutions: For API keys: we can issue scoped, short-lived keys from Console -> API Keys (TTL). For SSO: we support SAML/Okta; we'll need SP metadata and contact. For Private/VPC: need customer CIDR and whether they want peering or IP allowlist.

bryan-eng: Quick CLI for policy we can apply: ```
# apply burst policy
redwood pools update pool-78f9 \
  --baseline-gpus 4 \
  --burst-max 8 \
  --burst-cooldown 1800 \
  --hard-limit 9
```

deploy-bot: pool provisioning started -> POOL-REQUEST-1923 accepted. Expected completion: 2026-04-01 03:20 UTC. Provisioned pool id=pool-78f9 (us-west-2). Console: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/pool-78f9

sean-sales: tagging ACME (@acme-eng) — please confirm SAML contact and CIDR. Also confirm 4 devs need temp keys. We'd like a strict "no-overage" demo mode if possible.

acme-eng: Confirmed. SAML contact: samir@acme.com. CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16. Yes, need 4 temp API keys for devs. Demo team prefers hard cap over alerts.

maria-solutions: Got it — I'll create 4 keys with TTL=72h, scope=[ingest,generate], and send encrypted keys to Samir. Also will enable hard_limit on the pool per request.

anya-finance: I set a $500 demo cap and requested alerts to finance @50% and @80%. Overage blocked unless finance approves.

bryan-eng: Policy applied to pool-78f9. Burst cooldown=1800s, burst_max=8, hard_limit=9, monitoring hooks enabled. I'll watch telemetry during tonight's test and can rollback burst immediately if we see instability.

sean-sales: Awesome — removing the blocker for the sales demo. Thanks everyone! :tada:
